limits: Self-selected public Google Play reviews from a fixed historical window; not the customer population.
No revenue, plan tier or confirmed cancellation data: cancellation language is expressed intent only.
Labels come from a small model; verifier and golden-set agreement facts show their reliability.
The first and last calendar months of the window are partial.
The baseline score is complaint_count x mean_severity (= severity_sum); it measures review volume weighted by described impact, not business value.
question: Where should the next quarter of product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

ranking.description: Customers report being unable to choose songs, skip or return to previous tracks, rewind, or repeat playback without Premium. Some describe the free tier as having too many restrictions or say the app pushes them toward Premium.
ranking.name: Free-Tier Playback Restrictions

ranking.description: Customers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, describing it as bad, disappointing, or worse than before. They do not identify a specific feature or problem.
ranking.name: General App Dissatisfaction

ranking.description: Customers report that ads are too frequent, sometimes playing after only one or two songs or instead of songs. One customer says the ads are too loud.
ranking.name: Frequent and intrusive ads

ranking.description: Customers report songs playing randomly within a playlist, music adjustment not working properly, and basic music-player features being unavailable.
ranking.name: Playback Controls Behave Unexpectedly

ranking.description: Customers say an update made the app feel unusable and dislike the new home screen. One customer says there is no clear way in settings to disable automatic playback.
ranking.name: App Update and Settings Usability

ranking.description: Customers say they cannot get into their account or that their password is not accepted.
ranking.name: Unable to Log In With Account Credentials

ranking.description: Customers say the app crashes when they try to open it or remains stuck on the loading or logo screen.
ranking.name: App Crashes or Gets Stuck Loading

ranking.description: Customers say offline listening does not work and song downloads can remain stuck in the background.
ranking.name: Offline Downloads Fail or Get Stuck

ranking.description: Customers report that lyrics are absent or do not appear for some songs.
ranking.name: Lyrics Sometimes Missing

ranking.description: Customers say many songs are unavailable and that gospel music is limited.
ranking.name: Missing Music in the Catalog

ranking.description: One customer calls the app bad because it supports LGBTQ people.
ranking.name: Objection to LGBTQ support

ranking.description: A customer says they are unable to connect to the internet.
ranking.name: Internet Connection Errors
